hypotheses.reasoning: order-service heap climbs (78%→84%→90% after full GC, old gen not reclaimed), suggesting an unbounded orderCache leak. That ends in an OutOfMemoryError at orderCache.put and OOMKill restarts every ~3 minutes, which matches the bursts of gateway 502s. I found no deploy in the logs and no errors in the other services.
A cache change may have caused the leak, but no release appears in the logs.

verdict.recommendedAction: Put a size limit or TTL on orderCache in order-service (or raise its memory limit for now), take a heap dump to confirm the leak, and restart the affected pods.
